items.title: Environment variable silently forces a non-anonymizing mock backend

findings.title: Environment variable silently forces a non-anonymizing mock backend
findings.explanation: backend.load() returns the mock module whenever RADVEIL_SLICER_MOCK is set, regardless of the Developer-mode checkbox. The mock 'does NOT anonymize' (mock_radveil.py docstring), yet Anonymize still writes an 'Anonymized volume' and a report. The UI does show 'mock backend active' and the button suffix, but a user who inherited that variable from the environment could release unprotected data believing it was defaced. Scripted runs have no such warning.
findings.suggestion: Limit the mock to explicit developer use (e.g. require Developer mode for the env var too), and make the run fail or show a red verdict when the mock backend is active in an Anonymize run.

items.title: Transitive dependencies of the radveil wheel not inspected

findings.title: Transitive dependencies of the radveil wheel not inspected
findings.explanation: The module installs radveil>=0.1,<0.2 into Slicer's Python. The README says no ML framework is needed, but I could not check the wheel's dependency closure for pins or downgrades of packages Slicer bundles (for example numpy) or for PyTorch pulled from PyPI.
findings.suggestion: Verify radveil's Requires-Dist metadata on PyPI for abi3 wheels and state in the review that its dependency tree is compatible with Slicer's bundled packages.

items.title: Catalog revision 'release' existence could not be verified

findings.title: Catalog revision 'release' existence could not be verified
findings.explanation: The entry relies on the 'release' branch, which RELEASING.md says is only created by tagging v0.1.0 through the release workflow. If the branch does not exist yet, the index cannot build the extension. I could not check the remote repository from here.
findings.suggestion: Confirm that rAum/SlicerRadVeil has a 'release' branch pointing at a tagged v0.1.0 commit before merging, and record the commit examined.
